title: Plainwright pages
description: Named pages for feature files: I open the "Login" page. The key is the page name.

elements.description: Names for elements without a usable visible name (aliases). The key is the name used in feature files, or name and type as written in the step ("\"Settings\" button"); the value is a selector.

url.description: Address of the page, relative to baseURL ("/login") or absolute. * stands for any text without /, ** for any text; such a page can only be checked (I am on the "..." page), not opened.
